data.one_liner: A Dart 3-native Flutter router using sealed routes and pattern matching.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe navigation for Flutter applications using Dart 3 sealed classes, exhaustive pattern matching, and a stack-as-state model instead of string paths or code generation.
use_when: You want compile-time type safety for routes and parameters without code generation.
You prefer a stack-as-state navigation model driven by sealed classes.
You need modular or deep-linkable routing with guarded pipelines.
avoid_when: Your project must rely strictly on URL string paths as the primary source of truth.
You are not using Dart 3 sealed classes.
strengths: Compile-time type safety and exhaustiveness checking for route switches.
No code generation or manual equality boilerplate required.
Built-in support for shells, lazy branches, and guards.
weaknesses: Requires adherence to sealed class route hierarchies.
Differs significantly from traditional path-based routers like go_router.
data.setup_notes: None required beyond adding the package and setting up the router configuration in MaterialApp.router.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer traditional string paths and URL-centric navigation.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generated route management with builder configurations.
